name: Daniel Alegre
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: Yuga Labs tweeted that the Twitter account of the company's new CEO, Daniel Alegre, was hacked and is now under hacker control. Yuga Labs reminds users not to click on any minting links, nor to interact with any twitter accounts named Daniel Alegre until the official update notice is released, the Yuga Labs team is working with twitter to regain control of the account .
